5-7 years relevant experience

Under the general direction of the Department of Pediatrics Chief Administrative Officer and the Division Chiefs, the Division Administrator will be responsible for organization of work, supervision of administrative staff, staff development across all levels, budgets and financial control, and process improvement and problem solving in the delivery of related program services within assigned divisions.

Assigned Divisions may change over time, but the position will initially be assigned to the Divisions of CAND, Pulmonary, and Exercise Medicine which consist of approximately 22 academic positions, plus an additional 20 staff positions.

In conjunction with the Division Chiefs, the incumbent will be responsible for participating in the development and implementation of long-range planning of the divisions as well as management and supervision of all operations within the divisions. The incumbent will coordinate all administrative functions for the divisions in support of its research, clinical service and teaching operations.
Thorough knowledge of University rules and regulations, processes, protocols and procedures for budget, accounting and fund management, and / or personnel management.
Interpersonal skills including verbal and written communication, active listening, critical thinking, persuasiveness, advising and counseling skills.

Knowledge of a variety of administrative operational activities such as event planning, basic fundraising processes, risk management planning, website design, accounting and payroll, and contracts and grants regulations and guidelines.
Solid knowledge of common University-specific computer application programs.
Ability to use discretion and maintain confidentiality.
Strong skills in short-term planning, analysis, problem-solving, and customer service.
Thorough knowledge of financial analysis and reporting techniques, and / or human resources policies and procedures for staff and academic employees.
